body:
Fixes #1013.

`questionOtherKey` routed keys by hand and bound a short list, so in a question's own answer box the usual text-editing keys did nothing: `cmd+←`/`cmd+→` never reached the ends of the line, `cmd+delete` never killed to the line start, and `opt+delete`/`ctrl+delete` never deleted a word — while the message box directly beneath the question answered to every one of them.

The row now reads the surface's one word-and-line vocabulary (`editorMotion` / `editorWordKill` in `internal/tui3/editkeys.go`), the same door every other box on the surface goes through, and gains the line kill's two names (`ctrl+u`, `super+backspace`). `ctrl+w` stays out on purpose: on this surface it shuts the tab in front.

- `internal/tui3/question.go` — the routing; the hand-rolled chord list is gone.
- `internal/tui3/question_test.go` — a new test walks every chord family (cmd/super/opt/ctrl + ←→, `ctrl+a`/`ctrl+e`, `ctrl+u`, cmd/opt/ctrl+delete) through the row's own box, asserts the edit is not reaching the message box, and checks the edited words still travel as the answer.
- `internal/manual/chat/keys.md` + `questions.md` — the box is now on the list of boxes that answer the caret vocabulary (the manual law).

## Checks

- `go test ./internal/tui3/ -run Question` — passes.
- Each new family was proved to bite: disabling only the motion guard, only the word kill, or only the line kill each turns the new test red, with the chord named in the failure.
- The `pr-ready` light gate passed whole (build, vet, fmt, changelog, manual gates, laws, every package). Its heavy half (`test-touched` → `./internal/tui3`) refused to start because another session holds the box's heavy-suite lock (pid 94903); the focused `-run Question` run above is the evidence for the touched package.
